name: 赛博动漫
description: 锐利动画线稿与电青洋红反光交织，明暗分区鲜明，具有冷峻未来感。
rendering_prompt: Shape the subject with sharp two-dimensional animation linework and clearly separated cel-shaded light and shadow. Keep details precise and contours hard-edged. Create strong warm-cool tension with electric cyan, magenta, and deep blue, adding restrained neon reflections and a faint damp sheen. Introduce a precise mechanical rhythm within the existing structure. Keep shadows legible and the overall effect sharp, futuristic, emotionally intense, and distinctly drawn.
avoid: 自动添加城市或机械肢体、混成纯三维霓虹
difference: 赛博动漫靠线稿和机械节奏；合成波靠电子图形与速度感
tuning: 保留原有结构，仅在已有轮廓和材料上布置有限霓虹反光。
